needed.evidence: footway exists but is under 1m wide and obstructed, creating a tripping hazard
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk wider than 1m along the left side to ensure pedestrian safety from vehicular traffic.

needed.evidence: footway obstructed by parked vehicles and overgrown plants
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions, clear vegetation, and ensure the footway remains unblocked to provide safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: uneven sections and debris on footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the footway surface to eliminate tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: uneven footway surface and potential obstructions
needed.suggestion: Repair the uneven sections of the right-side footway to improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility despite pedestrian crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Install marked zebra crossings with adequate signage at points where pedestrians are attempting to cross to facilitate safe crossing.

needed.evidence: Crossing demand not facilitated and no refuge on a wide road
needed.suggestion: Introduce a pedestrian refuge island to allow people to cross the wide road safely in stages, especially where crossing activity is observed.
